images.name: holds-empty
images.note: No hold at all: one line "ไม่มีรายการค้าง", no table, and the help line still shown.

images.name: holds-with-rows
images.note: Two UNRESOLVED holds with the six columns, the two per-row buttons, and the reason box.

images.name: holds-breach-row
images.note: A breach row: the settled actual above the bound, "ใช้เกินที่กันไว้" and only the รับทราบ button.

images.name: holds-locked-company
images.note: ARCHIVED company: the hold is visible and every button is gone, with the reason named.

images.name: holds-release-confirm
images.note: The confirm dialog for a release: the amount, that the credit returns immediately, that no cost is recorded, and the late-evidence promise.

images.name: holds-after-release
images.note: After the release: that row is gone from the list, and the money position above it moved.

images.name: holds-charge-confirm
images.note: The confirm dialog for charge-at-bound: the amount becomes real spend, and it is not a model call.

images.name: holds-after-charge
images.note: After charge-at-bound: the OCR row of the position table shows the bound as SPENT, not held.

images.name: holds-acknowledge-confirm
images.note: The confirm dialog for an acknowledgement: no money moves, the scope reopens, check the cap first.

images.name: holds-after-acknowledge
images.note: After the acknowledgement: the list is empty, so nothing on this company is closing a scope any more.

images.name: holds-history
images.note: The adjustment history: the three decisions in Thai, each with its actor and its reason.
